fullPassage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. As she stood in line, she could feel those experiences were finally so close. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She realized she had left her passport at home. Her plans were ruined. She was heartbroken, knowing she could not board the flight and had to delay her dream trip.

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her (A)[expectations / disappointments] about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. As she stood in line, she could feel those experiences were (B)[finally / never] so close. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt (C)[nothing / everything].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Maya의 유럽 배낭여행에 대한 기대는 정말 높았다. 그 경험들이 마침내 아주 가까이 느껴졌다. 주머니에 손을 넣었지만 아무것도 느낄 수 없었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① expectations — finally — nothing: 원문 일치
❌ ② disappointments(실망)는 반의어
❌ ③ never(절대 ~않다)는 반의어
❌ ④ everything(모든 것)은 반의어
det.tip: expectations↔disappointments, finally↔never, nothing↔everything

When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. She realized she had (B)[left / brought] her passport at home. Her plans were (C)[ruined / fulfilled].

det.analysis:
✅ ③ forward — left — ruined: 원문 일치
❌ ① backward(뒤로)는 forward의 반의어
❌ ② brought(가져왔다)는 left의 반의어
❌ ④ fulfilled(이루어진)는 ruined의 반의어
det.tip: look forward to = ~을 기대하다, left(두고 왔다)↔brought(가져왔다), ruined↔fulfilled

Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She (B)[realized / forgot] she had left her passport at home. She was (C)[heartbroken / delighted], knowing she could not board the flight.

det.analysis:
✅ ④ approached — realized — heartbroken: 원문 일치
❌ ① avoided(피했다)는 approached의 반의어
❌ ② forgot(잊었다)는 realized의 반의어
❌ ③ delighted(기뻐하는)는 heartbroken의 반의어
det.tip: approached↔avoided, realized↔forgot, heartbroken↔delighted

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really ①<u>high</u>. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She couldn't wait to visit museums in Madrid and see the Eiffel Tower at night in Paris. When she approached the counter, the airline employee asked to see her passport. Maya reached into her pocket and felt nothing. She realized she had left her passport at home. Her plans were ②<u>ruined</u>. She was ③<u>heartbroken</u>, knowing she could not ④<u>miss</u> the flight.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①높은 ②망가진 ③가슴이 찢어지는 ④놓치다(→board 탑승하다)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ miss(놓치다)는 board(탑승하다)의 반의어. '비행기를 놓칠 수 없다'는 것은 이미 탑승 불가 상황에서 문맥상 모순. 원문은 'could not board(탑승할 수 없다)'
❌ ①②③ 원문 일치
det.tip: miss↔board. could not board the flight = 비행기에 탑승할 수 없었다

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. She was heartbroken, knowing she could not board the flight and had to ④<u>accelerate</u> her dream trip.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①가까운 ②여권 ③깨달았다 ④가속하다(→delay 미루다)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ accelerate(가속하다)는 delay(미루다)의 반의어. 여권을 잊어서 여행을 '가속'한다는 것은 문맥상 모순
❌ ①②③ 원문 일치
det.tip: accelerate(가속하다)↔delay(미루다, 연기하다). 여권을 잊으면 여행을 미뤄야 함

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. ❌ ①②④ 원문 일치
det.tip: secured(보장된, 안전한)↔ruined(망가진). 여권 분실 → 계획 망가짐(ruined)

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. det.korean: 그녀는 __________을(를) 집에 두고 왔다는 것을 깨달았습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ passport: 비행기 탑승에 필요한 여권
❌ ① luggage(짐) — 이미 체크인 줄에 서 있으므로 부적절
❌ ② ticket(표) — 체크인 시 여권 확인이 필수
❌ ④ wallet(지갑) — 직원이 여권을 요청했으므로
det.tip: passport = 여권. 국제선 탑승 시 필수 서류

det.korean: 비행기에 탈 수 없다는 것을 알고 __________했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② heartbroken: 여권 분실로 꿈의 여행을 미뤄야 해서 마음이 찢어지는

❌ ③ amused(즐거워하는) — 상황에 맞지 않음

det.tip: heartbroken = 비탄에 빠진. 꿈의 여행을 놓친 상황

det.korean: 마드리드에서 __________을(를) 방문하고 파리에서 에펠탑을 보고 싶어했습니다.

✅ ④ museums: 마드리드의 관광 명소
❌ ① factories(공장) — 여행 목적에 맞지 않음
❌ ② offices(사무실) — 관광과 무관
❌ ③ hospitals(병원) — 관광과 무관
det.tip: museums = 박물관/미술관. 마드리드의 대표 관광지(프라도 미술관 등)

det.analysis:

❌ ③ confused(혼란스러운) — 의미 다름
❌ ④ satisfied(만족한) — 반의어
det.tip: heartbroken = devastated = grief-stricken = crushed

det.korean: 카운터에 다가갔을 때, 항공사 직원이 여권을 요청했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ neared: 가까이 갔다 — approached의 동의어
❌ ① departed(떠났다) — 반의어
❌ ② avoided(피했다) — 반의어
❌ ④ ignored(무시했다) — 의미 다름
det.tip: approach = near = come close to = draw near

questions.passage: Maya waited in line to check in for her flight. Her expectations about her European backpacking trip were really high. She had been looking forward to the trip for a year. det.korean: 꿈의 여행을 미뤄야 했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② postpone: 연기하다 — delay의 동의어
❌ ① cancel(취소하다) — 연기와 취소는 다름
❌ ③ begin(시작하다) — 반의어
❌ ④ enjoy(즐기다) — 맥락 반대
det.tip: delay = postpone = put off = defer

det.korean: 여권을 집에 두고 왔다는 것을 깨달았다.
det.analysis:

det.korean: 그녀의 계획이 망가졌다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ preserved: 보존된 — ruined(망가진)의 반의어
❌ ① destroyed(파괴된) — 동의어
❌ ② wrecked(부서진) — 동의어
❌ ③ damaged(손상된) — 유사어
det.tip: ruined(망가진) ↔ preserved(보존된), saved(구원된), intact(온전한)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'line'의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) Maya는 비행기 체크인을 위해 줄을 서서 기다렸다. (B) 선생님은 수학 문제를 설명하기 위해 칠판에 곧은 선을 그었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 줄, 대기열 — (B) 선, 직선
❌ ① 의미 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)가 부정확
❌ ④ (A)가 부정확
det.tip: line: ① 줄, 대기열 (wait in line) ② 선, 직선 (draw a line)
